correctness.summary: Equality in the published per-level private-witness bound forces every k-level to be a full sunflower with a (k-1)-element core. The NOC witness condition between consecutive saturated levels forces these cores to form a strict chain, giving exactly the ordered extremal family. The converse is the known sharpness construction after relabeling. The core chain also proves uniqueness up to swapping the last two labels, hence n!/2 labeled extremizers for n>=2. Direct exhaustive verification for n<=4 and Hasse checks through n=10 agree with the proof.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The full Lindeberg--Hellmuth arXiv v1 proves the n(n+1)/2 bound and gives one extremal construction but does not classify equality cases or give the n!/2 count. The accessible full text of the earlier strict-compatibility paper was checked around its characterization and contains no such extremal theorem. Exact and synonymous searches found no nested-core equality classification or equivalent network enumeration. Older private-element set-system literature and very recent unindexed parallel work remain residual risks.

value.summary: The result upgrades a sharp bound with one example to a complete rigidity theorem, exactly enumerates the labeled extremizers, and determines the Hasse arc and reticulation counts of every extremal regular normal realization. Via the published NOC-network bijections it also enumerates the maximally cluster-rich networks in two canonical normal-network classes.

limitations: Only exact equality cases are classified; no near-extremal stability theorem is proved.
The result does not enumerate all NOC set systems.
The n!/2 network counts concern the two canonical classes in the published bijections, not all non-regular network realizations of an extremal clustering system.
Older set-system literature under different terminology and very recent unindexed work remain residual originality risks.
Finite computation supports but does not replace the proof.
Independent audit has not been performed.
